chunks: So he searched their saddle-bags before his brother's, then produced the cup from his brother's bag. That is how We planned an excuse for Joseph, for under the law of the king he could not detain his brother unless God so willed. We raise the status of whom We please. Over every man of knowledge there is one more knowing.
ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'kidhn' in the story of Joseph and how did it relate to the royal law?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the concept of *kidhn* (divine preparation) where God orchestrated the events to fulfill the prophecy given to Jacob, demonstrating that Joseph's retention of Benjamin was not merely a legal maneuver but a divine decree. The phrase 'We prepared for Joseph' underscores God's active role in history, while the concluding affirmation of His knowledge above all scholars reinforces the Shia emphasis on divine wisdom guiding human actions. This event serves as a pivotal moment in the narrative of the twelve tribes, illustrating how divine will operates through natural means and legal frameworks.
